name: Haunted Self
description: Someone they lost still lives inside them, speaking through their choices
behavioral_signature: Makes decisions partly as themselves and partly as a dead person
under_stress: The dead voice gets louder than their own
at_rest: Carries on conversations with someone no one else can see
will_always: consider what the dead would have wanted
will_never: fully let go of the person they carry
unless: the ghost's wishes conflict with the living's survival
